attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

private theorem addressRename {α β : Type} (c e k : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (addressTerm c e k).relabel j = addressTerm (c.relabel j) (e.relabel j) (k.relabel j) := by
  simp only [addressTerm,consTerm,pairTerm,addRelabel,mulRelabel,sucRelabel,zRelabel,numeralRename]

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}

/-- Two-argument congruence of the sparse cell constructor, from the actual
constructor graph: move both inputs along the equations, then use that the
constructor program has one value. -/
private theorem consEqual (x y u v : OTerm α)
    (first : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn x u)))
    (second : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn y v))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn (rawCons x y) (rawCons u v))) := by
  let before : Fin 2 → OTerm α := ![x,y]
  let after : Fin 2 → OTerm α := ![u,v]
  have input (i : Fin 2) :
      Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (arithmeticEmbedding.onFormula ((before i).equal (after i)))) := by
    rw [onEquality]
    exact Fin.cases first (Fin.cases second (fun n => Fin.elim0 n)) i
  have old : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph fieldCons (rawCons x y) before)) :=
    consGraph x y
  unfold programGraph at old
  have moved : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph fieldCons (rawCons x y) after)) := by
    unfold programGraph
    exact graphInputTransport body α 2 Γ (OrdinaryArithmetic.graphFormula fieldCons)
      (rawCons x y) before after input old
  exact valueUnique fieldCons (rawCons x y) (rawCons u v) after moved (consGraph u v)

private theorem auxiliaryEqual (d e l a d' e' l' a' : OTerm α)
    (hd : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn d d')))
    (he : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn e e')))
    (hl : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn l l')))
    (ha : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn a a'))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn (auxiliaryTerm d e l a) (auxiliaryTerm d' e' l' a'))) := by
  have h4 := consEqual a z a' z ha ⟨refl z⟩
  have h3 := consEqual l _ l' _ hl h4
  have h2 := consEqual e _ e' _ he h3
  have h1 := consEqual d _ d' _ hd h2
  exact consEqual _ _ _ _ ⟨refl _⟩ h1

private theorem addressEqual (c e k c' e' k' : OTerm α)
    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn c c')))
    (he : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn e e')))
    (hk : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn k k'))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn (addressTerm c e k) (addressTerm c' e' k'))) := by
  have h3 := consEqual k z k' z hk ⟨refl z⟩
  have h2 := consEqual e _ e' _ he h3
  have h1 := consEqual c _ c' _ hc h2
  exact consEqual _ _ _ _ ⟨refl _⟩ h1

/-- Move all three inputs of one ternary program call along equations. -/
private theorem ternaryTransport (p : Program 3) (out c e raw c' e' raw' : OTerm α)
    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn c c')))
    (he : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn e e')))
    (hr : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn raw raw')))
    (old : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph p out ![c,e,raw]))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph p out ![c',e',raw'])) := by
  let before : Fin 3 → OTerm α := ![c,e,raw]
  let after : Fin 3 → OTerm α := ![c',e',raw']
  have input (i : Fin 3) :
      Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (arithmeticEmbedding.onFormula ((before i).equal (after i)))) := by
    rw [onEquality]
    exact Fin.cases hc (Fin.cases he (Fin.cases hr (fun n => Fin.elim0 n))) i
  have start : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph p out before)) := old
  unfold programGraph at start
  have moved : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph p out after)) := by
    unfold programGraph
    exact graphInputTransport body α 3 Γ (OrdinaryArithmetic.graphFormula p) out before after input start
  exact moved

/-- The original output report at the literal output address: the supplied
least call is the genuine single witness, and the address equation is
reflexivity. -/
private theorem outputFromLeast (least : Program 3) (ctx cod raw m : OTerm α)
    (selected : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph least (suc m) ![ctx,cod,raw]))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (outputReport least ctx cod raw (addressTerm ctx cod m))) := by
  obtain ⟨actual⟩ := selected
  rw [reportUnfold]
  apply Nonempty.intro
  apply Derivation.existentialIntroduction (emb m)
  rw [reportInstance]
  exact Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction actual (refl (addressTerm ctx cod m))

/-- The five operand fields that pin the block witnesses: context, domain,
codomain and class of the function address, and the class of the argument
address. The domain and codomain fields come from the literal sparse cell in
the function's result slot. -/
private theorem operandFields (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α)
    (functionReport : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)))
    (argumentReport : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawContext ctx qf)) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawDomain dom qf)) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawCodomain cod qf)) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast fn qf)) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast arg qa)) := by
  obtain ⟨fr⟩ := functionReport
  obtain ⟨ar⟩ := argumentReport
  have leftContext : Derivation body Γ (unary rawContext ctx qf) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.conjunctionRight fr)
  have leftResult : Derivation body Γ (unary rawResult (rawCons dom cod) qf) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight fr))
  have leftLeast : Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast fn qf) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight fr))
  have rightLeast : Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast arg qa) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight ar))
  obtain ⟨cell⟩ := canonicalCell (body := body) (Γ := Γ) dom cod
  have cellDom : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary cellHead dom (rawCons dom cod))) :=
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.conjunctionRight cell)⟩
  have cellCod : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary cellTail cod (rawCons dom cod))) :=
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight cell)⟩
  have domainField : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawDomain dom qf)) :=
    makeUnary cellHead rawResult dom qf (rawCons dom cod) cellDom ⟨leftResult⟩
  have codomainField : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawCodomain cod qf)) :=
    makeUnary cellTail rawResult cod qf (rawCons dom cod) cellCod ⟨leftResult⟩
  exact ⟨⟨leftContext⟩,domainField,codomainField,⟨leftLeast⟩,⟨rightLeast⟩⟩

/-- Functionality of the original application row for an arbitrary least
program. Open the six-witness block, identify every fresh witness that the
output report uses with the caller's coordinate by functionality of the five
field programs, move the held least call to the witnesses, and let the
accepted same-input coherence of output reports fix the output. -/
private theorem rowFunctional (least : Program 3) (qf qa y ctx dom cod fn arg m : OTerm α)
    (context : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawContext ctx qf)))
    (domain : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawDomain dom qf)))
    (codomain : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawCodomain cod qf)))
    (fnField : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast fn qf)))
    (argField : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast arg qa)))
    (selected : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (programGraph least (suc m) ![ctx,cod,auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg])))
    (bound : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (someRow least qf qa y))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn y (addressTerm ctx cod m))) := by
  apply rowCases least qf qa y (eqn y (addressTerm ctx cod m)) bound
  intro β j Δ c r d e l a keep known
  rw [eqnRelabel,addressRename]
  have context' := renameInto context j Δ keep
  have domain' := renameInto domain j Δ keep
  have codomain' := renameInto codomain j Δ keep
  have fnField' := renameInto fnField j Δ keep
  have argField' := renameInto argField j Δ keep
  simp only [unaryRename] at context' domain' codomain' fnField' argField'
  have selected' := renameInto selected j Δ keep
  simp only [programRename,threeRename,sucRelabel,auxiliaryRename] at selected'
  obtain ⟨known⟩ := known
  have parsed : Derivation body Δ
      (parsedApplicationInputs (qf.relabel j) (qa.relabel j) c r d e l a) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft known
  have output : Derivation body Δ
      (outputReport least c e (auxiliaryTerm d e l a) (y.relabel j)) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionRight known
  have fields := Derivation.conjunctionRight
    (Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight parsed))
  have leftFields : Derivation body Δ (addressReports (qf.relabel j) c r l) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft fields
  have rightFields : Derivation body Δ (addressReports (qa.relabel j) c d a) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.conjunctionRight fields)
  have arrowFields : Derivation body Δ (arrowReports (qf.relabel j) d e) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight fields))
  obtain ⟨sameContext⟩ := valueUnique rawContext (ctx.relabel j) c ![qf.relabel j] context'
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft leftFields⟩
  have sameFunction := valueUnique rawLeast (fn.relabel j) l ![qf.relabel j] fnField'
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight leftFields)⟩
  have sameArgument := valueUnique rawLeast (arg.relabel j) a ![qa.relabel j] argField'
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight rightFields)⟩
  have sameDomain := valueUnique rawDomain (dom.relabel j) d ![qf.relabel j] domain'
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft arrowFields⟩
  obtain ⟨sameCodomain⟩ := valueUnique rawCodomain (cod.relabel j) e ![qf.relabel j] codomain'
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight arrowFields⟩
  have sameAuxiliary := auxiliaryEqual (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (fn.relabel j)
    (arg.relabel j) d e l a sameDomain ⟨sameCodomain⟩ sameFunction sameArgument
  have moved := ternaryTransport least (suc (m.relabel j)) (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
    (auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (fn.relabel j) (arg.relabel j))
    c e (auxiliaryTerm d e l a) ⟨sameContext⟩ ⟨sameCodomain⟩ sameAuxiliary selected'
  have emitted := outputFromLeast least c e (auxiliaryTerm d e l a) (m.relabel j) moved
  obtain ⟨first⟩ := coherent least c e (auxiliaryTerm d e l a) (y.relabel j)
    (addressTerm c e (m.relabel j)) ⟨output⟩ emitted
  obtain ⟨back⟩ := addressEqual c e (m.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (m.relabel j)
    ⟨symm sameContext⟩ ⟨symm sameCodomain⟩ ⟨refl (m.relabel j)⟩
  exact ⟨trans first back⟩

theorem exact_InstalledApplicationOutputFunctionality :
    ExactInstalledApplicationOutputFunctionality := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg m y Q
    functionReport argumentReport least accepted
  obtain ⟨context,domain,codomain,fnField,argField⟩ :=
    operandFields qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg functionReport argumentReport
  obtain ⟨accepted⟩ := accepted
  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_InstalledApplicationReport V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other
    body α Γ qf qa y
  have reported : Derivation body Γ (applicationReport Q.scalar Q.least qf qa y) :=
    Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft law) accepted
  have selected : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (programGraph Q.least (suc m) ![ctx,cod,auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg])) := least
  exact rowFunctional Q.least qf qa y ctx dom cod fn arg m context domain codomain fnField
    argField selected ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight reported)⟩

theorem exact_InstalledApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation :
    ExactInstalledApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg goal Q
    syn ty result functionReport argumentReport functionAccepted argumentAccepted finish
  obtain ⟨context,domain,codomain,fnField,argField⟩ :=
    operandFields qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg functionReport argumentReport
  apply exact_InstalledApplicationFrontendAcceptance V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other body α Γ
    qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg goal syn ty result functionReport argumentReport
    functionAccepted argumentAccepted
  intro β j Δ m keep least report accepted graph
  apply finish β j Δ m keep least report accepted graph
  intro y
  let call : Formula β := programGraph Q.application (suc z) ![qf.relabel j,qa.relabel j,y]
  have keep' : ∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ call :: Δ :=
    fun p hp => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (keep p hp)
  have context' := renameInto context j (call :: Δ) keep'
  have domain' := renameInto domain j (call :: Δ) keep'
  have codomain' := renameInto codomain j (call :: Δ) keep'
  have fnField' := renameInto fnField j (call :: Δ) keep'
  have argField' := renameInto argField j (call :: Δ) keep'
  simp only [unaryRename] at context' domain' codomain' fnField' argField'
  have selected : Nonempty (Derivation body (call :: Δ)
      (programGraph Q.least (suc m) ![ctx.relabel j,cod.relabel j,
        auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (fn.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)])) := by
    have moved := least
    rw [auxiliaryRename] at moved
    obtain ⟨moved⟩ := moved
    exact ⟨Derivation.weakening (fun p hp => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hp) moved⟩
  have here : Derivation body (call :: Δ) call := Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self
  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_InstalledApplicationReport V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other
    body β (call :: Δ) (qf.relabel j) (qa.relabel j) y
  have reported : Derivation body (call :: Δ)
      (applicationReport Q.scalar Q.least (qf.relabel j) (qa.relabel j) y) :=
    Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft law) here
  obtain ⟨same⟩ := rowFunctional Q.least (qf.relabel j) (qa.relabel j) y (ctx.relabel j)
    (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (fn.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) m
    context' domain' codomain' fnField' argField' selected
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight reported)⟩
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction same⟩

theorem exact_InstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation :
    ExactInstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s cv root other body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg goal Q
    syn ty functionReport argumentReport functionAccepted argumentAccepted finish
  obtain ⟨guards⟩ := syn
  exact exact_InstalledApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation V TV M M0 B T base s cv TV
    root other body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg goal ⟨guards⟩ ty
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight guards⟩ functionReport argumentReport functionAccepted
    argumentAccepted finish

#print axioms exact_InstalledApplicationOutputFunctionality
#print axioms exact_InstalledApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation
#print axioms exact_InstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationOutputFunctionalityProof

constructor graph: move both inputs along the equations, then use that the
constructor program has one value. -/
private theorem consEqual (x y u v : OTerm α)
    (first : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn x u)))
    (second : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn y v))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn (rawCons x y) (rawCons u v))) := by
  let before : Fin 2 → OTerm α := ![x,y]
  let after : Fin 2 → OTerm α := ![u,v]
  have input (i : Fin 2) :
      Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (arithmeticEmbedding.onFormula ((before i).equal (after i)))) := by
    rw [onEquality]
    exact Fin.cases first (Fin.cases second (fun n => Fin.elim0 n)) i
  have old : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph fieldCons (rawCons x y) before)) :=
    consGraph x y
  unfold programGraph at old
  have moved : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph fieldCons (rawCons x y) after)) := by
    unfold programGraph
    exact graphInputTransport body α 2 Γ (OrdinaryArithmetic.graphFormula fieldCons)
      (rawCons x y) before after input old
  exact valueUnique fieldCons (rawCons x y) (rawCons u v) after moved (consGraph u v)

private theorem auxiliaryEqual (d e l a d' e' l' a' : OTerm α)
    (hd : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn d d')))
    (he : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn e e')))
    (hl : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn l l')))
    (ha : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn a a'))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn (auxiliaryTerm d e l a) (auxiliaryTerm d' e' l' a'))) := by
  have h4 := consEqual a z a' z ha ⟨refl z⟩
  have h3 := consEqual l _ l' _ hl h4
  have h2 := consEqual e _ e' _ he h3
  have h1 := consEqual d _ d' _ hd h2

private theorem addressEqual (c e k c' e' k' : OTerm α)

    (he : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn e e')))

private theorem ternaryTransport (p : Program 3) (out c e raw c' e' raw' : OTerm α)

    (he : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn e e')))
    (hr : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn raw raw')))
    (old : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph p out ![c,e,raw]))) :

      Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (arithmeticEmbedding.onFormula ((before i).equal (after i)))) := by

private theorem outputFromLeast (least : Program 3) (ctx cod raw m : OTerm α)

    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawCodomain cod qf)) ∧

    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast arg qa)) := by

  have leftContext : Derivation body Γ (unary rawContext ctx qf) :=

  have leftResult : Derivation body Γ (unary rawResult (rawCons dom cod) qf) :=

    (argField : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast arg qa)))

      (programGraph least (suc m) ![ctx,cod,auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg])))

    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn y (addressTerm ctx cod m))) := by
  apply rowCases least qf qa y (eqn y (addressTerm ctx cod m)) bound
  intro β j Δ c r d e l a keep known
  rw [eqnRelabel,addressRename]
  have context' := renameInto context j Δ keep
  have domain' := renameInto domain j Δ keep
  have codomain' := renameInto codomain j Δ keep
  have fnField' := renameInto fnField j Δ keep

    Derivation.conjunctionLeft known

    Derivation.conjunctionLeft fields
  have rightFields : Derivation body Δ (addressReports (qa.relabel j) c d a) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.conjunctionRight fields)

    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft arrowFields⟩

    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight arrowFields⟩

  have leftResult : Derivation body Γ (unary rawResult (rawCons dom cod) qf) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight fr))
  have leftLeast : Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast fn qf) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight fr))
  have rightLeast : Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast arg qa) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight ar))

  have cellDom : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary cellHead dom (rawCons dom cod))) :=
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.conjunctionRight cell)⟩
  have cellCod : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary cellTail cod (rawCons dom cod))) :=
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight cell)⟩

    makeUnary cellHead rawResult dom qf (rawCons dom cod) cellDom ⟨leftResult⟩

    makeUnary cellTail rawResult cod qf (rawCons dom cod) cellCod ⟨leftResult⟩

/-- Functionality of the original application row for an arbitrary least
program. Open the six-witness block, identify every fresh witness that the
output report uses with the caller's coordinate by functionality of the five
field programs, move the held least call to the witnesses, and let the
accepted same-input coherence of output reports fix the output. -/
private theorem rowFunctional (least : Program 3) (qf qa y ctx dom cod fn arg m : OTerm α)
    (context : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawContext ctx qf)))
    (domain : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawDomain dom qf)))
    (codomain : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawCodomain cod qf)))
    (fnField : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast fn qf)))
    (argField : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary rawLeast arg qa)))
    (selected : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (programGraph least (suc m) ![ctx,cod,auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg])))
    (bound : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (someRow least qf qa y))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn y (addressTerm ctx cod m))) := by
  apply rowCases least qf qa y (eqn y (addressTerm ctx cod m)) bound
  intro β j Δ c r d e l a keep known
  rw [eqnRelabel,addressRename]
  have context' := renameInto context j Δ keep
  have domain' := renameInto domain j Δ keep
  have codomain' := renameInto codomain j Δ keep
  have fnField' := renameInto fnField j Δ keep
  have argField' := renameInto argField j Δ keep
  simp only [unaryRename] at context' domain' codomain' fnField' argField'
  have selected' := renameInto selected j Δ keep
  simp only [programRename,threeRename,sucRelabel,auxiliaryRename] at selected'
  obtain ⟨known⟩ := known
  have parsed : Derivation body Δ
      (parsedApplicationInputs (qf.relabel j) (qa.relabel j) c r d e l a) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft known
  have output : Derivation body Δ
      (outputReport least c e (auxiliaryTerm d e l a) (y.relabel j)) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionRight known
  have fields := Derivation.conjunctionRight
    (Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight parsed))
  have leftFields : Derivation body Δ (addressReports (qf.relabel j) c r l) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft fields
  have rightFields : Derivation body Δ (addressReports (qa.relabel j) c d a) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.conjunctionRight fields)
  have arrowFields : Derivation body Δ (arrowReports (qf.relabel j) d e) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight fields))
  obtain ⟨sameContext⟩ := valueUnique rawContext (ctx.relabel j) c ![qf.relabel j] context'
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft leftFields⟩
  have sameFunction := valueUnique rawLeast (fn.relabel j) l ![qf.relabel j] fnField'
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight leftFields)⟩
  have sameArgument := valueUnique rawLeast (arg.relabel j) a ![qa.relabel j] argField'
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight rightFields)⟩
  have sameDomain := valueUnique rawDomain (dom.relabel j) d ![qf.relabel j] domain'
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft arrowFields⟩
  obtain ⟨sameCodomain⟩ := valueUnique rawCodomain (cod.relabel j) e ![qf.relabel j] codomain'
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight arrowFields⟩
  have sameAuxiliary := auxiliaryEqual (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (fn.relabel j)
    (arg.relabel j) d e l a sameDomain ⟨sameCodomain⟩ sameFunction sameArgument
  have moved := ternaryTransport least (suc (m.relabel j)) (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
    (auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (fn.relabel j) (arg.relabel j))
    c e (auxiliaryTerm d e l a) ⟨sameContext⟩ ⟨sameCodomain⟩ sameAuxiliary selected'
  have emitted := outputFromLeast least c e (auxiliaryTerm d e l a) (m.relabel j) moved
  obtain ⟨first⟩ := coherent least c e (auxiliaryTerm d e l a) (y.relabel j)
    (addressTerm c e (m.relabel j)) ⟨output⟩ emitted
  obtain ⟨back⟩ := addressEqual c e (m.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (m.relabel j)
    ⟨symm sameContext⟩ ⟨symm sameCodomain⟩ ⟨refl (m.relabel j)⟩
  exact ⟨trans first back⟩

theorem exact_InstalledApplicationOutputFunctionality :
    ExactInstalledApplicationOutputFunctionality := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg m y Q
    functionReport argumentReport least accepted
  obtain ⟨context,domain,codomain,fnField,argField⟩ :=
    operandFields qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg functionReport argumentReport
  obtain ⟨accepted⟩ := accepted
  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_InstalledApplicationReport V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other
    body α Γ qf qa y
  have reported : Derivation body Γ (applicationReport Q.scalar Q.least qf qa y) :=
    Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft law) accepted
  have selected : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (programGraph Q.least (suc m) ![ctx,cod,auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg])) := least
  exact rowFunctional Q.least qf qa y ctx dom cod fn arg m context domain codomain fnField
    argField selected ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight reported)⟩

theorem exact_InstalledApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation :
    ExactInstalledApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg goal Q
    syn ty result functionReport argumentReport functionAccepted argumentAccepted finish
  obtain ⟨context,domain,codomain,fnField,argField⟩ :=
    operandFields qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg functionReport argumentReport
  apply exact_InstalledApplicationFrontendAcceptance V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other body α Γ
    qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg goal syn ty result functionReport argumentReport
    functionAccepted argumentAccepted
  intro β j Δ m keep least report accepted graph
  apply finish β j Δ m keep least report accepted graph
  intro y
  let call : Formula β := programGraph Q.application (suc z) ![qf.relabel j,qa.relabel j,y]
  have keep' : ∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ call :: Δ :=
    fun p hp => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (keep p hp)
  have context' := renameInto context j (call :: Δ) keep'
  have domain' := renameInto domain j (call :: Δ) keep'
  have codomain' := renameInto codomain j (call :: Δ) keep'
  have fnField' := renameInto fnField j (call :: Δ) keep'
  have argField' := renameInto argField j (call :: Δ) keep'
  simp only [unaryRename] at context' domain' codomain' fnField' argField'
  have selected : Nonempty (Derivation body (call :: Δ)
      (programGraph Q.least (suc m) ![ctx.relabel j,cod.relabel j,
        auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (fn.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)])) := by
    have moved := least
    rw [auxiliaryRename] at moved
    obtain ⟨moved⟩ := moved
    exact ⟨Derivation.weakening (fun p hp => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hp) moved⟩
  have here : Derivation body (call :: Δ) call := Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self
  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_InstalledApplicationReport V TV M M0 B T base s cv tv root other
    body β (call :: Δ) (qf.relabel j) (qa.relabel j) y
  have reported : Derivation body (call :: Δ)
      (applicationReport Q.scalar Q.least (qf.relabel j) (qa.relabel j) y) :=
    Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft law) here
  obtain ⟨same⟩ := rowFunctional Q.least (qf.relabel j) (qa.relabel j) y (ctx.relabel j)
    (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (fn.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) m
    context' domain' codomain' fnField' argField' selected
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.conjunctionRight reported)⟩
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction same⟩

theorem exact_InstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation :
    ExactInstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s cv root other body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg goal Q
    syn ty functionReport argumentReport functionAccepted argumentAccepted finish
  obtain ⟨guards⟩ := syn
  exact exact_InstalledApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation V TV M M0 B T base s cv TV
    root other body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg goal ⟨guards⟩ ty
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight guards⟩ functionReport argumentReport functionAccepted

# Fable-2 ledger

## G01 — output address

### Plan (written before the target was frozen)

1. The output address is not an address of `auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg` itself. The original
   frontend's `outputReport least ctx cod aux y` says `y = addressTerm ctx cod k` where `k` is the
   packed least of `aux`. So the term is `q := addressTerm ctx cod m` with `m` the measured least of
   the auxiliary term, and its report is `addressReport q ctx cod m` (class field `m`, not `aux`).
2. `m` is fresh: it comes out of `hasLeast` (integration statement, `casesLeast`), so the result is
   in continuation form over `(β) (j : α → β) (Δ) (m : OTerm β)`.
3. Report formula: `addressReport (addressTerm ctx cod m) ctx cod m` — unconditional, from
   `NumberedWindowInternalAtomicRefinementObjectSelectorsProof.literalAddress`.
4. Acceptance predicate: `unary Q.scalar (suc z) q`, via `exact_InstalledCarrierFromCoordinates`,
   which needs four coordinates at `(ctx, cod, m)`:
   - `unary cv (suc z) ctx` — from `exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates` on the function address;
   - `windowAt Q.window ctx cod m` — `exact_OpenCoverCombinedWrappedAuxFormation` gives the window
     at `aux`; `exact_SelectedWindowFromRetained exact_RetainedPredecessor` moves it to the least;
   - `leastGraph … ctx cod m m` (the fixed point) — `exact_CoveredLeastIdempotent`, applicable
     because `thinPairedExchange`/`thinMatchingWindow` are literal recuts of
     `pairedExchange`/`coveredWindow` (expected definitional; the gate decides);
   - `unary tv (suc z) cod` — NOT derivable: `tv` is an arbitrary program and the operands only give
     `tv (rawCons dom cod)` and `tv dom`. It is also necessary (Coordinates applied to the conclusion
     returns it). Kept as one explicit result-type guard.
5. Second statement: at `tv := TV` that guard is the right half of the retained syntax guard, so
   only the two original type guards remain.
6. Not attempted: packaging into `programGraph Q.application (suc z) ![qf,qa,q]` (needs
   `arrowGood qf`, `arrowReports`, the two shell equations and a six-witness block).

### Targets (frozen before proof authoring)

- `LogicLineages/PersistentMarking/NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationOutputAddressTargets.lean`
  sha256 `7164f6998e96658f10e0a5e55b9cfbb821de9655aef7262e0254b521afaf8eca` (2026-11-23T01:21Z)
  - `ExactInstalledApplicationOutputAddress`
  - `ExactInstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputAddress`

### Receipts

- 2026-11-23T01:28Z — gate `mathlib …OutputAddressProof`, attempt 1 of 1: `COMPILE_PASS` for
  Targets and Proof. Receipt `build-reports/1795397242217822492-3231382.json`
  (sha256 `6f255001348057c2d37b2a6b31ba867356dd46cfdcad7655397028b8e47d5c3d`).
  Proof module sha256 `492c77121cf8bd9f02361f4b45ec8788db06636382e7b0b4bf7cc2f4797519ab`.
  Targets sha256 re-checked after the pass: unchanged.
  `#print axioms`: both theorems `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.

### Failures

None. The one open expectation in the plan (that `thinPairedExchange` / `thinMatchingWindow` unfold
to `pairedExchange` / `coveredWindow` so the accepted idempotence applies) held in the kernel.

### State and next

PASSED. `exact_InstalledApplicationOutputAddress` and
`exact_InstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputAddress` are gated. Evidence in
`OUTPUT-ADDRESS-EVIDENCE.json`, scope in `OUTPUT-ADDRESS-SOURCE-MAP.md`.

Still explicit: the two original type guards; in the general statement also `unary tv (suc z) cod`
(necessary, not derivable for arbitrary `tv`; gone at `tv := TV`).

Next: frontend acceptance `programGraph Q.application (suc z) ![qf,qa,addressTerm ctx cod m]` via
`exact_InstalledApplicationReport`. Missing inputs to state exactly: `unary arrowGood (suc z) qf`,
`arrowReports qf dom cod`, and the shell equations for `qf`, `qa` (recoverable from
`ExactOpenAddressArrowCoordinates`), then a six-witness `block` introduction around
`outputReport Q.least ctx cod aux q` — the last conjunct is exactly what this step's continuation
supplies (`leastGraph` is `programGraph Q.least (suc m) ![ctx,cod,aux]` by definition).

## G02 — frontend acceptance

### Plan (written before the proof was drafted)

Goal: `programGraph Q.application (suc z) ![qf,qa,addressTerm ctx cod m]` for the same fresh `m` as
G01, in continuation form, through the backward half of `exact_InstalledApplicationReport`.
`applicationReport i least f u y = unary i 1 f ⊓ (unary i 1 u ⊓ block (applicationRow least f u y))`,
and the row is `parsedApplicationInputs f u ctx result dom cod fn arg ⊓ outputReport …`.

Grep check of the four ingredients (each against an accepted supplier):

1. `unary arrowGood (suc z) qf` — DERIVABLE. `arrowGood = applyUnary cellGood rawResult`; the function
   report gives `unary rawResult (rawCons dom cod) qf`; `canonicalCell dom cod`
   (`…SparsePathEnvelopeOpenCellProof`) gives `cellGood` of `rawCons dom cod`; `makeUnary`
   (`…SparsePathEnvelopeOpenSyntaxProof`) composes them.
2. `arrowReports qf dom cod` — DERIVABLE the same way (`rawDomain`/`rawCodomain` are
   `applyUnary cellHead/cellTail rawResult`; `canonicalCell` gives head `dom`, tail `cod`).
3. Shell equation `qf = addressTerm ctx result fn` and `result = rawCons dom cod` — DERIVABLE:
   `assembleInputs` (`…SparseApplicationFrontendOpenShapeProof`, public) produces the whole
   `parsedApplicationInputs` from the two `addressGood`s, `arrowGood`, the two `addressReports` and
   `arrowReports`, via `exact_OpenAddressArrowCoordinates`.
4. Shell equation `qa = addressTerm ctx dom arg` — DERIVABLE, same `assembleInputs` (its private
   `argumentEquation` uses `readNode`).

`addressGood` and `addressReports` for both operands are the literal conjuncts of `addressReport`.
Six-witness `block` introduction: accepted supplier exists — `supply`
(`…SparseApplicationFrontendOpenBindingProof`, public); no private lemma needed.
`outputReport` introduction: `reportUnfold` + `Derivation.existentialIntroduction (emb m)` +
`reportInstance` (`…SparseApplicationOutputCoreReportSyntaxProof`), with the G01 least call and
`refl` for the address equation.

So NO new hypothesis is expected: the target has exactly the G01 premises and adds one conjunct
(the application graph) to the continuation. Inputs are assembled in `Γ`, then moved to `Δ` with
`renameInto` + `inputsRename`; witness for `result` is `(rawCons dom cod).relabel j` left unrewritten.
Open expectations for the gate: (a) `Q.least` unifies with `packedLeastProgram Q.source.cover
Q.exchange Q.window s` (projection of `install`); (b) `unary`/`applyUnary` definitional unfolding
suffices for `arrowGood`/`arrowReports`/`addressReports` without rewriting.

### Targets (frozen before proof authoring)

- `LogicLineages/PersistentMarking/NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationFrontendAcceptanceTargets.lean`

  - `ExactInstalledApplicationFrontendAcceptance`

  `#print axioms`: both theorems `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.

### Failures

None. Both open expectations held: `Q.least` unified with the `packedLeastProgram` inside
`leastGraph`, and `arrowGood` / `arrowReports` / `addressReports` needed no rewriting.

### State and next

PASSED. `exact_InstalledApplicationFrontendAcceptance` and
`exact_InstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationFrontendAcceptance` are gated. Evidence in
`FRONTEND-ACCEPTANCE-EVIDENCE.json`, scope in `FRONTEND-ACCEPTANCE-SOURCE-MAP.md`.

All four handoff ingredients (`arrowGood qf`, `arrowReports qf dom cod`, both shell equations) were
derived from the two operand `addressReport`s; the block came from the accepted `supply`. No
premise was added to G01's. Private glue in the proof module: `parsedFromReports`,
`outputFromLeast`.

Still explicit (inherited): the two original type guards; in the general statement
`unary tv (suc z) cod`. Observation for whoever states the next step: the application-graph
conjunct alone does not use the `tv` guard — only G01's scalar-acceptance conjunct does.

Next: closure of the installed carrier under application as one statement — the set
`{q | unary Q.scalar 1 q}` with reports is closed under the installed application program
(existence, done here; plus functionality: any `y` with `programGraph Q.application 1 ![qf,qa,y]`
equals the emitted address). Candidate route, UNCHECKED: forward half of
`exact_InstalledApplicationReport`, identify its fresh block witnesses with `ctx, dom, cod, fn, arg`
through the shell equations, then `coherent` in `…SparseApplicationReinstallReportCasesProof`.
After that, the two type guards: at `tv := TV` operand acceptance gives `TV (rawCons dom cod)` and
`TV dom`; whether an accepted arrow-inversion law for `TV` / the refit guard exists was not
grepped.

## G03 — output functionality

### Plan (written before the proof was drafted)

Goal: any `y` with `programGraph Q.application (suc z) ![qf,qa,y]` equals `addressTerm ctx cod m`
for the measured least `m` of `auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg`.

Route checked by reading/grep (each step against an accepted public supplier):

1. Forward half of `exact_InstalledApplicationReport` gives `applicationReport Q.scalar Q.least qf qa y`;
   its third conjunct is `someRow Q.least qf qa y`. `rowCases`
   (`…SparseApplicationFrontendOpenBindingProof`, public) opens the six-witness block to fresh
   `c r d e l a` with `parsedApplicationInputs qf qa c r d e l a ⊓ outputReport least c e (aux d e l a) y`.
2. Identify the fresh witnesses with the user's coordinates by `valueUnique` on the field programs:
   `rawContext` (`ctx = c`), `rawLeast` on `qf` (`fn = l`) and on `qa` (`arg = a`), `rawDomain`
   (`dom = d`), `rawCodomain` (`cod = e`). The user-side `rawDomain`/`rawCodomain` facts come from
   `canonicalCell` + `makeUnary`, as in G02. `r` is not needed.
3. Term congruence. NOT accepted under any name: grep for
   `eqn (rawCons …) (rawCons …)` / `eqn (auxiliaryTerm …) (auxiliaryTerm …)` finds only the private
   one-argument `addressEqual` in `…SparseApplicationReinstallResultProof`. Proved here instead, by
   the same method: `consGraph` (`…SparsePairGraphProof`, public) + `graphInputTransport` +
   `valueUnique fieldCons` gives two-argument congruence of `rawCons`; `auxiliaryTerm` and
   `addressTerm` are literal nests of `rawCons`/`consTerm` (expected definitional; the gate decides).
4. Move the held least call to `![c,e,aux d e l a]` by `graphInputTransport`, build
   `outputReport least c e (aux d e l a) (addressTerm c e m)` (G02's `outputFromLeast`, re-proved
   privately), apply `coherent` (`…SparseApplicationReinstallReportCasesProof`, public) against the
   row's own output report: `y = addressTerm c e m`; then address congruence back to `ctx, cod`.

So NO missing ingredient is expected: no uniqueness-of-reports premise, no injectivity of
`addressTerm`, no type guard. Statements:

- held-least form: two operand reports + `leastGraph … m` + acceptance of `y` ⊢ `eqn y (addressTerm ctx cod m)`;
- continuation form on #1440's exact premises: the continuation additionally receives, for every
  `y` of the extended context, the internal implication `accepted(qf,qa,y) → y = addressTerm ctx cod m`
  (via `Derivation.weakening` + `implicationIntroduction`); and its `tv := TV` variant.

Open expectations for the gate: (a) `auxiliaryTerm`/`addressTerm` unify with nested `rawCons` for
`consEqual`; (b) `simp only [programRename,threeRename,sucRelabel,auxiliaryRename]` normalises the
renamed least call.

# Paper 16: the installed application program has one output on accepted operand addresses

Continues `FRONTEND-ACCEPTANCE-SOURCE-MAP.md` (G02, record #1440) at the same `install …` route.
That step proved the installed application program accepts `(qf, qa, addressTerm ctx cod m)`; this
step proves it accepts nothing else on `(qf, qa)`. Supporting result; no numbered statement is
closed and no register item is promoted.

Gate: receipt `build-reports/1795398283787789332-3247930.json`, first attempt. Hashes and axiom
lines in `OUTPUT-FUNCTIONALITY-EVIDENCE.json`.

## Claimed

`ExactInstalledApplicationOutputFunctionality` (theorem
`exact_InstalledApplicationOutputFunctionality`) — held-least form. For the installed route
`Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv tv root other`, any ID1 body, context `Γ` and terms: from
derivations in `Γ` of

- `addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn`,
- `addressReport qa ctx dom arg`,
- `leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg) m`, and
- `programGraph Q.application (suc z) ![qf, qa, y]`,

there is a derivation in `Γ` of `eqn y (addressTerm ctx cod m)`. No type guard and no scalar
acceptance is a premise of this form.

`ExactInstalledApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation` (theorem of the same name with
`exact_`) — continuation form on exactly #1440's premises (two type guards, `unary tv (suc z) cod`,
the two operand reports, installed-scalar acceptance of both operands). The object continuation
over `(β) (j) (Δ) (m)` receives #1440's four conjuncts unchanged and a fifth: for every
`y : OTerm β`, a derivation in `Δ` of the internal implication

`programGraph Q.application (suc z) ![qf, qa, y]  →  eqn y (addressTerm ctx cod m)`

(operands and coordinates relabelled along `j`), for the same fresh `m`.

`ExactInstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation`: the same at `tv := TV`,
where the result type guard is the right half of the retained syntax guard and disappears.

### How the uniqueness is obtained — every step from an accepted supplier

| Step | Supplier |
|---|---|
| acceptance of `y` ⇒ `applicationReport Q.scalar Q.least qf qa y` | forward half of `exact_InstalledApplicationReport` |
| open the six-witness block to fresh `c r d e l a` | `rowCases` (`…SparseApplicationFrontendOpenBindingProof`) |
| `ctx = c`, `fn = l`, `arg = a`, `dom = d`, `cod = e` | `valueUnique` on `rawContext`, `rawLeast` (at `qf` and at `qa`), `rawDomain`, `rawCodomain`; the caller-side domain/codomain fields from `canonicalCell` + `makeUnary` |
| held least call moved to `![c, e, auxiliaryTerm d e l a]` | `graphInputTransport` |
| `y = addressTerm c e m` | `coherent` (`…SparseApplicationReinstallReportCasesProof`) between the row's own `outputReport` and the one built from the moved least call (`reportUnfold` / `reportInstance`) |
| `addressTerm c e m = addressTerm ctx cod m` | cell congruence (below) |

Proved privately in the proof module because no accepted statement exists under any name (grep
for `eqn (rawCons …) (rawCons …)` / `eqn (auxiliaryTerm …) (auxiliaryTerm …)` finds only the
private one-argument `addressEqual` in `…SparseApplicationReinstallResultProof`):

- `consEqual`: `x = u`, `y = v` ⊢ `rawCons x y = rawCons u v`, from the public `consGraph`,
  `graphInputTransport` and `valueUnique fieldCons`;
- `auxiliaryEqual`, `addressEqual`: all-argument congruence of `auxiliaryTerm` and `addressTerm`,
  which are literal nests of that cell constructor.

## Assumed (explicit premises that remain)

- Held-least form: only the four derivations listed above. The least `m` is a premise there, not
  produced.
- Continuation forms: #1440's premises unchanged — the two original type guards
  (`TV` and `refitGuard s T` at `dom`, `cod`), and in the general statement `unary tv (suc z) cod`.
  These are consumed only by #1438's scalar-acceptance conjunct; the functionality conjunct does
  not use them.
- Axioms: `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` only. No `sorry`, `axiom`, `native_decide`.

Not assumed, although the task allowed for it: uniqueness of the operand reports for a given
address (it is functionality of the field programs), injectivity of `addressTerm` (the row is
entered through its field reports, not its shell equations), any arrow guard, arrow report, shell
equation or block witness.

## Not claimed

- A single internally quantified formula `∀ y (accepted → y = …)`: the fifth conjunct is a schema
  over terms `y` of the extended context, each instance an internal implication.
- A separate statement that the measured least is unique (two least calls on one triple agree by
  `valueUnique` + `cancelSuc`; used only implicitly through `coherent`).
- Functionality in the operands (that equal or equivalent operand addresses give equal outputs),
  or anything about operands whose reports sit at different contexts.
- Removal of the two type guards; whether an accepted arrow-inversion law for `TV` /
  `refitGuard` exists was not grepped.
- Closure of the carrier `{q | unary Q.scalar (suc z) q}` under application packaged as one
  statement; existence (#1438, #1440) and functionality (this step) are separate `Prop`s sharing
  one continuation.
- Any numbered statement of Paper 16.
